action.objective: Verify g1f3 as the natural developing move, comparing it to the broad-search leader.
action.rationale: Broad search ranked g1f3 top (67, depth 3) but completed only depth 3, so no move is commit_ready yet. g1f3 develops a minor, fights for the center, and the reserved verification budget (2000 nodes) is specifically held for it. Verifying it at depth 4 aims to convert the exact depth-3 evidence into a commit-ready move.
